summary: BKV Corporation filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, announcing a private Rule 144A offering of convertible senior notes due 2031, initially proposed at $400 million aggregate principal and subsequently upsized to $500 million at a 1.625% coupon, with an additional $75 million option granted to initial purchasers. The notes and any conversion shares remain unregistered, requiring an exemption from registration. Proceeds are unallocated in the excerpt. Watch conversion premium, initial conversion price, and potential equity overhang upon settlement.
